profile.name: Aarav Sharma
profile.reason: The 50-hour battery life and fast charging are incredible for long study sessions and daily commuting without needing constant recharges.

conversation.question: What matters most to you when choosing a product like this?
conversation.answer: For me, it really comes down to practicality and value. As an engineering student, I’m always on the move between lectures, the library, and my dorm, so battery life and durability are huge. I hate having to constantly worry about finding an outlet or babying my tech. At the same time, I’m on a tight budget, so it has to be priced right—I won't pay extra for flashy branding or features I'll never actually use. If it's reliable, lasts all day, and doesn't break the bank, that’s an instant win for me.

conversation.question: What would make you choose this product?
conversation.answer: Honestly, what clinched it for me was the 50-hour battery life and fast charging. As an engineering student constantly on campus, I don't have time to constantly plug things in, and this gives me amazing value for my budget.

profile.name: Ananya Iyer
profile.reason: ENC calling is a lifesaver for my back-to-back client calls in noisy environments, though I would have liked more premium color options.

conversation.question: What matters most to you when choosing a product like this?
conversation.answer: Honestly, functionality that keeps up with my hectic schedule is a total non-negotiable. I'm constantly hopping between back-to-back client calls while managing campaigns, so I need something reliable—like ENC calling—that actually filters out background noise so I don't have to repeat myself. But since I'm always on camera and care a lot about aesthetics, it also has to look sleek and chic with my outfits. Performance and style, both matter equally to me.

conversation.question: What would make you choose this product?
conversation.answer: For me, it’s all about the Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC). Since I'm always on back-to-back client calls in noisy coffee shops or transit, I chose it because it keeps my voice crystal clear. Though I really wish it came in more stylish, premium colors to match my aesthetic!

profile.name: Rohan Verma
profile.reason: While the deep bass sounds fun, the overall soundstage lacks clarity and detail in the mid and high frequencies for serious music mixing.

conversation.question: What matters most to you when choosing a product like this?
conversation.answer: For me, it’s all about absolute sonic accuracy and translation. When I’m mixing a track, I need to hear every single detail across the entire frequency spectrum—crisp highs, clean, separated mids, and a tight, honest low end that doesn't lie to me. If a pair of headphones or monitors colours the sound too much just to make things "sound fun," it's useless to me in the studio. Transparency and a wide soundstage are non-negotiable.

conversation.question: What would make you choose this product?
conversation.answer: To be honest, I wouldn't choose it as my main device. Even though the deep bass is fun for casual listening, the soundstage just lacks the clarity and detail in the mids and highs that I need for serious music mixing.

profile.name: Neha Patel
profile.reason: The battery life sounds great, but the charging case looks too bulky to fit comfortably in my small sling bags and trendy pockets.

conversation.question: What matters most to you when choosing a product like this?
conversation.answer: Honestly, aesthetics and size are huge for me. Since I’m always running between classes and the design studio, whatever I carry has to actually fit in my tiny sling bags or the pockets of my cargo pants without ruining the silhouette of my outfit. It needs to look sleek and minimalist—like, if it doesn't match my vibe or takes up too much space, I'm just not going to use it, no matter how good the tech specs are.

conversation.question: What would make you choose this product?
conversation.answer: I almost bought it because the battery life sounds amazing, but what stopped me is the charging case. It's just too bulky to fit comfortably into my small sling bags and trendy pockets. If they made a sleeker, more minimalist case, I'd reconsider.
